title: Specialist Detector, Correction, and Benefit-Gate Framework
mission: Implement and evaluate the first complete set of regime specialists with learned activation, bounded correction and abstention.
steps: Pre-register marine suppression, weak-wind heat, MAM transition, cloud/rain suppression, cool-surge rebound, dry subsidence, TC-peripheral proxy, hot/cold asymmetry and high-error tail hypotheses.
Use official-only long history where appropriate and modern NWP frame where required.
Generate cross-fitted regime probabilities, corrections and expected benefit.
Apply sample support and no-harm gates.
Preserve negative specialists and failure reasons.
acceptance: Only specialists meeting all evidence gates promoted
failure: Sparse/unstable specialist rejected or shrunk to zero
